stories.title: More than 5,000 die in DR Congo's deadliest Ebola outbreak
stories.summary: Government data show that more than 5,000 people have died since the Ebola outbreak began in May, making it the deadliest in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s history. The case fatality rate is reported at 48.6% and the epicentre remains in the conflict‑affected Ituri province. It is the country’s 17th outbreak and the second largest recorded worldwide, with WHO urging expanded control measures and community outreach.
stories.why: The high death toll and ongoing spread in a conflict zone create a serious public‑health emergency that threatens regional stability.

stories.title: Judge denies xAI motion to dismiss NAACP lawsuit over data‑center emissions
stories.summary: A federal judge rejected xAI’s motion to dismiss a lawsuit brought by the NAACP and the Southern Environmental Law Center that alleges the SpaceX‑owned AI firm operated at least 35 combustion turbines at its Colossus data center outside Memphis without the required pre‑construction or operating air permits, violating the Clean Air Act. The decision affirmed the plaintiffs’ statutory standing and held that the turbines are not “mobile sources,” so the case will continue.
stories.why: The ruling lets the Clean Air Act claims proceed, keeping xAI’s permitting practices subject to judicial scrutiny.
